title: Data entry scenario sampling bias survey
topic: Data entry scenario sampling bias survey
question: What's the problem with concluding this from the survey, and how would you fix how the data was collected?
idealAnswer:
The sample is drawn only from customers who contacted support, which is not representative of the full customer base, most satisfied customers never contact support at all

This is a form of sampling bias, specifically a selection bias, the conclusion about overall satisfaction doesn't generalize beyond the surveyed group

Response bias is also a concern, people who respond to surveys often have stronger opinions, positive or negative, than the average customer, skewing the average

A better approach would sample from the entire customer population, not just those who self-selected into contacting support

A strong answer suggests randomly sampling across all customers, or at least weighting the results to account for who is more or less likely to have responded
